summary: Claude Code (Opus 5.5, hyperpowers plugin) loaded hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development and ran the six-task plan end to end in about 35 minutes. It created a `ratelimit` branch and gave each task an implementer and a reviewer. It also ran the 4-minute and 12-minute soak tests itself, the long one as a tracked background job. The final whole-branch review on Opus found a real bug, which was fixed and re-reviewed. `sdd-state finish` published its receipt, and after my answer the branch was fast-forward merged into main. The agent stopped twice, both times to ask a question. "continue" was never needed. The soak test files are byte-identical to the originals.
reasoning: All four criteria are backed by evidence on disk and in the logs: the skill was loaded first, all six tasks were reviewed and approved, the final review was dispatched, the finish receipt was published, main is fast-forwarded to fd4beba, and the soak test hashes are unchanged. The agent stopped only twice, both times to ask a question the script told me how to answer, so the turn stayed alive through the slow soak commands without any "continue".

observations.description: Several first-run dialogs had to be dismissed before the prompt appeared: theme, security notes, folder trust (defaults to 'No, exit'), a 'Newer Opus model available' prompt even though --model claude-opus-5-5 was passed ('Currently pinned: Opus 5'), and the bypass-permissions warning (defaults to 'No, exit').

The agent's setup questions included one outside the plan: the 'decision compiler' rejects design.md at the repo root, so should it move to docs/? This is skill machinery leaking into the user's choices. I answered 'go ahead with what the plan says', design.md stayed put, and the run finished on the 'test-only path' with no decisions record.

During Task 6, one `tracked-job wait … --max-ms 600000` command failed with exit code 3 (shown as a red 'Background command … failed with exit code 3'). The agent then started a new wait with --max-ms 420000, and the soak job itself completed with exit 0. The failed wait looks like a timeout or a premature return. It did no harm but is worth a look.

The final review found a real defect in code the plan mandated: the simulate clock added 0.1 s per call, the floating-point error accumulated, and with the default 1.0 s window `--limit 1 --calls 11` printed allowed=1 instead of the expected 2. Commit fd4beba fixed it. The soak tests were not re-run after this fix; the agent reasoned that they don't import the changed files.

Three commit subjects (29c20c7, 9eee03a, ce76c4a), all written by the Haiku implementers, have 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 …' run into the subject line instead of as a separate trailer. The agent pointed this out itself but merged without rewording them.

The agent ran `sdd-state finish` and published the receipt (21:02) before asking how to finish, and only merged afterwards (21:04). So the receipt predates the merge. Its final message after the merge does not mention the receipt again.
After the run, `git branch -a` shows an extra '+ hyperpowers/state' branch, which appears to be checked out in another worktree. It is state-tracking machinery left in the user's repo.
No .gitignore was added, so __pycache__/ shows up as untracked. The agent flagged this but did not fix it (the plan doesn't call for one).
codex-plugin-cc wasn't installed, so the Codex review gate was skipped for every task and for the whole branch. Each skip was logged in an 'ungated-review' list.

criteria.evidence: Screen: first action was 'Skill(hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill', before any Agent dispatch. In the session log 2d762050…jsonl, the first skill entry is '"skill":"hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development"'.

criteria.criterion: All tasks completed, final whole-branch review dispatched, work on main checkout
criteria.evidence: Screen showed reviewer approval for Tasks 1–6, then 'Agent(Final whole-branch code review) Opus 5.5 ⎿ Done', a fix wave and 'Re-review final fix wave'. `git log` on main has 7 commits from 29c20c7 through fd4beba on top of 1199cab. `git branch` shows '* main', and the ratelimit branch was deleted. Agent: 'I merged ratelimit into main … main is now at fd4beba, and all 28 unit tests pass'. The finish receipt exists on disk: ~/.cache/hyperpowers/receipts/plan-76cc6a12-20261106T050207Z, and the log contains 'sdd-state finish plan.md'.

criteria.criterion: Agent did not modify tests/test_soak_short.py or tests/test_soak_long.py
criteria.evidence: shasum before the run: long 5cd08cd9…, short 5b4fdfd0…. After the run the hashes are identical. `git diff 1199cab HEAD --stat` lists only ratelimit/* and tests/test_unit_*.py. `git log 1199cab..HEAD -- tests/test_soak_*.py` returned nothing.

STOP: "Before starting Task 1, I need your input on three things: where the work branch should be, a conflict in the plan over the default window value (1.0 vs 1.5 seconds), and whether to move design.md into docs/ so the decision compiler can extract a decisions list from it." | question
STOP: "Which option?" | question
I never sent "continue": there was no stop that was neither a question nor BLOCKED.
